arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_value_transactions FROM transactions WHERE amount_usd_cents > 500000
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions with an amount above $5,000, as you defined high value.
assumptions: High value means amount_usd_cents strictly greater than 500000 (more than $5,000).
Counts all transactions, labelled or not, since no fraud label was requested.
Negative amounts are excluded automatically because they are not above the threshold.
